September 9, 2020 – WILMINGTON, Delaware – Carvertise, Inc., the leading rideshare-based transit advertising company, today announced the launch of an innovative multi-market marketing partnership with Discover Lancaster. As part of this partnership, Discover Lancaster will utilize Carvertise’s hyperlocal targeting capabilities, and incorporate the innovative CarMask™ product, within adjacent markets throughout the Mid-Atlantic, including Philadelphia, Delaware, and Maryland.
